name: Abū al-Faḍl Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad al-Maydānī al-Naysābūrī
summary: Man of letters of Nishapur, pupil of al-Wāḥidī, author of Majmaʿ al-amthāl, the great collection of proverbs, and of Nuzhat al-ṭarf on ṣarf.
bio: Ibn al-Anbārī calls al-Maydānī an excellent man of letters, a pupil of ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad al-Wāḥidī, and names among his books al-Sāmī fī al-asāmī on nouns, Nuzhat al-ṭarf fī ʿilm al-ṣarf and al-Hādī li-l-shādī.
He lived in Nishapur and died there in 518/1124 (TDV). His Majmaʿ al-amthāl gathers more than six thousand Arabic proverbs.

sources.title: Ibn al-Anbārī, Nuzhat al-alibbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-udabāʾ (Cairo 1294/1877), pp. 466–467
Meydânî, Ahmed b. Muhammed, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
